title: HTTP3: fix ASAN stack-use-after-return error
description:
The 'quic_stream_info' type is not supposed to be stored persistently in
file-scoped memory, it is stack memory from `dissect_quic_frame_type`.
Before this fix, subsequent calls into the HTTP/3 dissector would result
in invalid memory access.

The crash can be reproduced while processing frame 10 of:

    tshark -r test/captures/quic-fragmented-handshakes.pcapng.gz

This fixes the following error:

    ==67434==ERROR: AddressSanitizer: stack-use-after-return on address 0x7fffd49f8aa0 at pc 0x7fffea23bc4e bp 0x7fffffff1ff0 sp 0x7fffffff1fe8
    READ of size 4 at 0x7fffd49f8aa0 thread T0
    [Detaching after fork from child process 67441]
        #0 0x7fffea23bc4d in http3_packet_get_direction epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:691:44
        #1 0x7fffea23ee33 in dissect_http3_qpack_enc epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:1693:51
        #2 0x7fffea232cdc in dissect_http3_uni_stream epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:1796:18
        #3 0x7fffea231d26 in dissect_http3 epan/dissectors/packet-http3.c:1883:9
        ...
        #8 0x7fffeb01322c in process_quic_stream epan/dissectors/packet-quic.c:1464:9
        #9 0x7fffeb0107d0 in desegment_quic_stream epan/dissectors/packet-quic.c:1614:9
        #10 0x7fffeb009a92 in dissect_quic_stream_payload epan/dissectors/packet-quic.c:1813:5
        #11 0x7fffeb003653 in dissect_quic_frame_type epan/dissectors/packet-quic.c:2474:13
        #12 0x7fffeaffad46 in quic_process_payload epan/dissectors/packet-quic.c:3510:36

Fixes: v4.1.1rc0-41-g80f9a28921 ("Adding HTTP/3 dissection to Wireshark.")


(cherry picked from commit d9bd00a22fbdb65d01e93c0f67dde8ab8812f66e)

Relates to !12604
